data.title: Pennsylvania allocates $37m for more than 500 new EV charging ports
data.description: The US state of Pennsylvania has announced a multimillion dollar investment in public EV charging infrastructure. This will fund 515 new charging ports across five counties as part of the federal NEVI programme.

data.title: Believ takes over 110+ EV chargers in Brighton & Hove
data.description: UK charge point operator Believ has taken over more than 110 public EV chargers across 30 locations in the English city of Brighton & Hove. The chargers were previously operated by Blink Charging.

data.title: OEMs may have to take back EVs with faulty batteries
data.description: EU product safety law could provide buyers of electric cars with potentially defective high-voltage batteries an additional way to return their vehicles. The Offenburg Regional Court explicitly allows the reversal of the purchase in a case involving a Cupra Born based on the EU Product Safety Regulation.

data.title: EVP secures majority against binding EV quotas for large corporate fleets
data.description: The EU Commission's draft Auto Package previously included a passage stating that member states should receive specific mandates from 2030 to accelerate the adoption of electric company cars. In the European Parliament, the proposed binding quotas are now likely to be downgraded to voluntary targets.

data.title: Volkswagen pauses development of the ID.Golf
data.description: Volkswagen is temporarily pausing development work on the future ID.Golf. The automaker cites high cost pressure as the reason for the decision and plans to resume work as soon as the necessary investments can be secured.

data.title: E.ON acquires Smatrics EnBW Italia
data.description: After a two-year interlude, Smatrics EnBW is once again withdrawing from Italy and selling its four charging parks in the north of the country, to E.ON. The sites house a total of 64 fast-charging points. The purchase price is undisclosed.

data.title: Miele orders 840 electric transporters from Volkswagen Commercial Vehicles
data.description: Miele plans to expand its European service fleet with 840 battery-electric transporters from Volkswagen Commercial Vehicles. 440 vehicles are set to be deployed in Germany.

data.title: Allye introduces 400 kW fast charger with second-life batteries
data.description: British company Allye Energy has unveiled the MEV, a battery-buffered fast charger for depots. The system uses complete second-life batteries from EVs and is designed to provide up to 400 kW of charging power without necessarily requiring a more powerful grid connection.

data.title: Group14 to build battery material factory in Sagunt
data.description: US battery material manufacturer Group14, which specializes in silicon anodes, will in future also produce in Europe. The commitment to establish a production site in Spain is directly linked to a new capital increase - specifically, with a European investor.

data.title: Vingroup to build a €449-million EV plant in the Philippines
data.description: In an effort to strengthen its footprint in the Southeast Asian auto market, Vingroup - the parent company of VinFast plans to build a new EV manufacturing facility in the Philippines. The Vietnamese conglomerate will invest US$500 million (approx. €449 million euros) in the new site.

data.title: AMG Lithium opens test laboratory for solid electrolytes in Frankfurt
data.description: AMG Lithium has commissioned its new Performance Lab "PerLa" in Frankfurt, Germany. The company aims to test sulfide solid electrolytes under more realistic conditions in complete laboratory cells and further develop them with customers.

data.title: Nio Firefly receives battery upgrade in China – with swap option for existing customers
data.description: Nio is granting the Firefly in China another upgrade. While the power output was increased in spring 2026, the focus is now on the battery and, consequently, the range. The manufacturer has announced an option for a 60 kWh battery. This battery has the same dimensions as the 42 kWh battery, meaning existing customers can also opt for a battery swap.

data.title: Rivian boosts revenue thanks to R2 and VW partnership
data.description: Rivian's revenue grew by 38 per cent in the third quarter of 2026 to $2.16 billion. Both the EV manufacturer's deliveries and its software and services business saw significant growth. 16 per cent of the revenue alone came from the partnership with Volkswagen. Rivian has also raised its annual forecast.

data.title: BYD plots new battery-electric coach launch in UK
data.description: BYD is set to battery-electric coach in the UK market by the end of the year, according to Frank Thorpe, BYD's Managing Director for Commercial Vehicle UK. The model is said to be specifically developed for the UK market.

data.title: Ireland connects EV fleet depots to electricity flexibility markets
data.description: An Post and DHL Express Ireland are taking part in a new project that connects EV fleet depots directly to Ireland's electricity flexibility markets, allowing operators to adjust charging demand in response to grid conditions - and potentially generate new revenue.

data.title: The BMW iX3 50 xDrive:  is the Neue Klasse a breakthrough?
data.description: BMW is entering a new era with the iX3. The first production model of the Neue Klasse aims to impress with high efficiency, enormous range, new software, and bidirectional charging. But how well does the overall package work in everyday life? We tested the BMW iX3 50 xDrive for two weeks on highways, country roads, in city traffic, and as a mobile power storage unit – and encountered some surprises along the way.

data.title: UK government pledges £100m to cut public EV charging costs
data.description: The funding, which was included in the 2026 Autumn Budget, aims to lower charging prices for drivers who use 'local, lower-powered' chargers such as those installed on lampposts or pavements. The money will be distributed over the course of two years, starting from spring 2027.

data.title: Hyundai reveals UK pricing for new Ioniq 6
data.description: The Ioniq 6 has received a facelift, and with it, new UK pricing. Hyundai's updated electric saloon is now available to order from a starting price of £33,240. Deliveries are planned for early 2027.

data.title: CATL advances solid-state battery development to 20 Ah samples
data.description: According to Chinese media, CATL has expanded the development of its solid-state battery from a 10-Ah-class validation platform to test runs with 20-Ah samples. The company continues to aim for small-scale production in 2027 and is reportedly targeting an energy density of around 500 Wh/kg.

data.title: Vehicle recycling at VW: dismantling line opens in Zwickau
data.description: Volkswagen has opened its dismantling line at the Zwickau plant. From 2027, the new facility is expected to disassemble and recycle around 4,100 vehicles annually. Across the entire 'circular economy' business hub at the Zwickau site, an initial 100 jobs could eventually grow into 1,000 new positions.
